title: Story Time at Graddy's Playhouse
seo_title: Story Time at Graddy's Playhouse in Springfield, MO
description: Story time at Graddy's Playhouse features books about home, read with Adam Graddy's real estate team, plus a chance to see the brand new exhibit. The house has hands-on STEM activities and interactive pretend play spaces, including a real-life kitchen, living room, and backyard. It takes place Friday, December 4, 2026 at 10:30 AM at the Discovery Center of Springfield, 438 E St. Louis St., Springfield, MO, and is held every first Friday of the month.
venue: Graddy's Playhouse, Discovery Center of Springfield
